In a move that has sent shockwaves through the clubhouse in the middle of a championship window, the Oakland A's have traded franchise cornerstone Martin Richar
The writing was on the wall when Richards saw his role reduced to clear the runway for breakout star Ernesto Quintero (following the departure of Darrin Davis).
But moving him *now* defies all conventional baseball wisdom.
Richards isn't just a veteran expiring contract; he is the quiet heartbeat of the Oakland lineup. Just last season, he posted a staggering 6.8 WAR, hit 26 home
